definitions: A person employed to carry luggage and other loads, especially in a railway station, airport, or hotel.
An employee in charge of the entrance of a large building, such as a block of flats or a hospital.
A dark brown bitter beer brewed from malt parched with charcoal.
examples: The porter carried the suitcases to the room.
Ask the hospital porter for directions.
He ordered a pint of porter at the pub.
